subject: french
title: Environment and Ecology
welcome_lead: Sharing the Planet centres on environment, equality and human rights. Climate change demands vocabulary in every language.
final_note: The planet is shared — and so must be the language to defend it.

walkthroughs.body_html: Le rechauffement climatique menace l'ecosysteme. Use il est urgent de + infinitive.
Je trie mes dechets, je prends les transports en commun. Modal verbs: on devrait, il faudrait.
L'Accord de Paris (2015) ratified by 196 countries. Cite for authority: conformement a l'Accord de Paris.

mcqs.q: Which year was the Paris Agreement?

numericals.q: Target maximum global warming in degrees Celsius per Paris Agreement (above pre-industrial)?
